title: Payload — review.disputed
$comment: Binds to the exact eventId it targets: a vote does not follow an edit. Only a review or a response is a meaningful target; anything else is stored and ignored at projection. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
